disclaimerStrip.content: *Unlimited Ink Replenishment. Use the Epson Genuine Ink supplied with your ReadyPrint subscription. Subject to the ReadyPrint Terms of Use and the functional limitations for the printer hardware (ET-2980U 2,000 pages/month, ET-3850U 2,100 pages/month, ET-5850U 8,300 pages/month, ET-16650U 8,300 pages/month). See epson.com/readyprint-terms. All Unlimited Printing Plans require a 2-year commitment and printers must remain connected to the Internet. Available in the Contiguous US only.

slides.heading: Affordable Color Printing
slides.body: Each included set of Epson EcoFit<sup>®</sup> ink bottles is equivalent to about 80 ink cartridges¹.
slides.alt: EcoTank printer with ink bottles showing value comparison

slides.heading: Up to 3 Years of Ink Included in the Box²
slides.body: Large ink tanks reduce the hassle of frequently replacing ink cartridges.
slides.alt: EcoTank printer worry-free printing with included ink

slides.heading: Our Most Reliable EcoTank<sup>®</sup> Ever
slides.body: Unique permanent printhead with pro-grade engineering delivers improved everyday reliability.

slides.heading: Unique Epson PrecisionCore<sup>®</sup> Print Technology
slides.body: High 4,800 x 1,200 print resolution for sharp text & true photographic print quality.
slides.alt: High quality print samples from EcoTank

slides.heading: Get a New EcoTank Printer Plus Upgrades.
slides.body: Get a free printer upgrade every 2-years. Plus no up-front costs and a 30-day risk-free trial.
slides.alt: ReadyPrint - Get a New EcoTank Printer

slides.heading: Print All You Want Worry-Free
slides.body: With Automatic Ink Replenishment, Epson will ship you replacement ink before you run out.

slides.heading: Zero Page Limits & Overage Fees
slides.body: Epson ReadyPrint has zero page limits and overage fees. Just a predictable low monthly cost.

slides.heading: Premium White Glove Customer Support
slides.body: Get continuous printer coverage with dedicated agent support and next business day unit exchange.

hotspots.compositeAlt: EcoTank ET-2980U — front and scanner views

points.heading: Uniquely Keyed EcoFit<sup>®</sup> Ink Bottles
points.body: Makes refilling ink simple. No mess, no stress and no ink bottle mix-ups.

points.heading: Wireless Mobile Printing
points.body: Wirelessly print and scan from your PC or smart device⁴, including support for Apple<sup>®</sup> AirPrint<sup>®</sup>. Enjoy enhanced mobile printing from the Epson Smart Panel<sup>®</sup> App⁵.

points.heading: 1.44" Color Display
points.body: Designed for simple navigation and printer management.

points.heading: Stunning Print Quality
points.body: Powered by Epson PrecisionCore<sup>®</sup> print technology, EcoTank<sup>®</sup> produces incredible photographic print quality from a recognized leader in photographic printing.

points.heading: Robust Paper Handling
points.body: 100-sheet paper input tray and auto 2-sided printing.
